object: FIELD Index 0.8.23 / one held object + source witness + canonical packet egress cut
source_instruction: Take point; align to shared context; ship through/into/over/across FIELD INDEX without creating another control plane.
recovered: packet egress fields: OBJECT / AUTHORITY / STATE_IN / DELTA / EVIDENCE / STATE_OUT / RESIDUE / WAITING / NEXT / STOP
canonical one-bucket precedence: GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE
STOP dominates continuation: conditional → GATE; unresolved fact → RESIDUE; completed/no residue → ARCHIVE; never NEXT
NOW requires external CURRENT/native-host selection context; packet current/ACTIVE_NOW/status NOW/egress=NOW cannot self-promote
Tests A–H: STATE / RELATION / GESTURE / IDENTITY / REVERSAL / LIVE-PROVENANCE / RETURN / COMPRESSION
COAXIALITY: carrier relation, host semantics; geometry cannot mint domain meaning
delta: Repair the already-merged /lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs rather than adding a second reducer.
Expose exact EGRESS_FIELDS / RETURN_CLASSES / FIELD_BUCKETS and source-witness helpers from the same reducer.

Add FIELD-level reduceField(): NOW from CURRENT; semantic DELTA from Git after the CURRENT cut; GATE from CURRENT world/human gates plus unbacked ACTIVE WAITING conflicts; NEXT from CURRENT only and clipped to three; RESIDUE from held/parked/later material; ARCHIVE from removed history.
Filter generated NEXUS/COMMS refresh commits from semantic DELTA while preserving them as literal Git chronology.
Add SOURCE WITNESS for CURRENT / WAITING / QUEUE / ATLAS with SOURCE HEAD / DERIVED AT / SOURCE AGE / VALID|STALE|CONFLICT; freshness never changes authority.
Fold the cut into the existing FIELD re-entry CONVERGENCE block. CONVERGE now opens FIELD-local derived state; NEXUS and COMMS remain exactly reachable snapshots.
Bind packet egress and exact A–H KEEP/REPAIR/CONTRACT/DELETE audit into FIELD_INDEX_CONTRACT v0.4 without creating a new route, store, queue, dashboard or ontology.
Align agent transcript and public validator to the same reducer/precedence.

authority.now: /control/CURRENT.json only, or explicit native-host selection supplied as reducer context

audit.C: GESTURE — one gesture, one primary interpretation
audit.H: COMPRESSION — less exposed burden, named recoverable residue
audit.disposition: all applicable pass → KEEP; one bounded needed defect → REPAIR; structural redundancy/negative compression → CONTRACT/DELETE
audit.hard_fail: IDENTITY / REVERSAL / LIVE-PROVENANCE / RETURN block promotion

known_limits: The external writer that periodically commits NEXUS/COMMS snapshots is outside this repo's visible control path; this change semantically filters/demotes those refreshes but does not claim to stop the writer.
SOURCE HEAD uses each source's explicit revision timestamp when no content hash exists; it is intentionally not Git HEAD.
Source conflicts are exposed, not silently reconciled.
next: Run exact-head proof. If green, merge 0.8.23, close superseded reducer PRs, then RETURN to CURRENT and select one existing conversion consequence rather than extending aggregation architecture.
stop: No second reducer, static packet cache, packet dashboard, autonomous routing, self-activating NOW, or autoplayed NEXT.
